challenge.exploration_summary: The project is a Maven multi-module Java project, with the main sanitizer API and tests under owasp-java-html-sanitizer/src/main/java/org/owasp/html and src/test/java/org/owasp/html. Sanitizers.java exposes canned PolicyFactory presets and already has focused tests in SanitizersTest. HtmlPolicyBuilder already supports srcset via SrcsetAttributePolicy, so Sanitizers.java is a good place to add a higher-level responsive-image preset without duplicating URL parsing.
challenge.feature_spec: Add Sanitizers.RESPONSIVE_IMAGES, a canned PolicyFactory for responsive img markup. It allows img src, alt, integer width/height/border, srcset with existing URL-candidate sanitization, and sizes descriptors validated by a conservative character and comma-list policy. The existing Sanitizers.IMAGES policy remains unchanged for backward compatibility.
challenge.feature_rationale: Responsive images are a common modern HTML use case, and users of canned sanitizer policies currently need to build a custom HtmlPolicyBuilder policy to allow srcset safely. This belongs in Sanitizers because it composes existing sanitizer primitives into a reusable preset alongside FORMATTING, LINKS, TABLES, and IMAGES.
challenge.bug_description: Sanitizers.RESPONSIVE_IMAGES now permits data: URLs for img src and srcset candidates even though the canned policy is intended to allow only HTTP, HTTPS, and relative image sources. This can preserve attacker-controlled embedded payloads in sanitized markup and weakens the sanitizer's URL protocol boundary.

findings.description: The PR inserted the SIZES attribute policy before finishing the existing IMAGES PolicyFactory builder, leaving the declaration syntactically invalid and preventing the Java project from compiling. This also violated the stated requirement that Sanitizers.IMAGES remain unchanged.

RESPONSIVE_IMAGES allowed the data: protocol for both src and srcset even though the canned policy is documented and specified as allowing HTTP, HTTPS, and relative image sources. An input such as would be preserved by the PR, broadening the URL attack surface beyond the existing image preset.

self_review.fix_explanation: Restored the original IMAGES builder termination before adding the new responsive-image code, so the existing preset compiles and remains behaviorally unchanged. Kept RESPONSIVE_IMAGES wired to the existing src/srcset URL guards but limited protocols to http and https, preserving relative URLs while rejecting data: candidates. Added SanitizersTest coverage for responsive srcset/sizes behavior, malformed sizes rejection, IMAGES backward compatibility, and data: URL rejection.
